title: FDA cybersecurity management plan / 524B(b)(1) plan (DERIVED)
description: DERIVED from Sec. VI.B (nine elements) and Sec. VII.C.1 (what a 524B(b)(1) plan should also address). For a cyber device the plan is statutory: 'a plan to monitor, identify, and address, as appropriate, in a reasonable time, postmarket cybersecurity vulnerabilities and exploits, including coordinated vulnerability disclosure and related procedures'. Property names are ours; every property cites the requirement that asks for it.

cyber_device.description: Sec. 524B(c) determination (see examples/cyber-device-determination.yaml). When true, cvd_process, regular_cycle and out_of_cycle are statutory.

monitoring.description: VI.B-06 'Sources, methods, and frequency for monitoring and identifying vulnerabilities (e.g., researchers, NIST national vulnerability database (NIST NVD), third-party software manufacturers)'

kev_handling.description: VI.B-07 identify and address vulnerabilities in CISA's KEV catalog

periodic_security_testing.description: VI.B-08; V.C-39 'at regular intervals commensurate with the risk (e.g., annually)'

patch_timeline.description: VI.B-09; VII.C.1-08 'the timeline, with associated justifications, to develop and release required updates and patches'

regular_cycle.description: 524B(b)(2)(A): updates and patches for known unacceptable vulnerabilities 'on a reasonably justified regular cycle' (VII.C.1-09). 'The justification for the regular cycle should typically be included in the cybersecurity management plan' (fn65-01).

out_of_cycle.description: 524B(b)(2)(B): 'as soon as possible out of cycle, critical vulnerabilities that could cause uncontrolled risks' (VII.C.1-11).

patching_capability.description: VI.B-11 'rate at which update can be delivered to devices'

cvd_process.description: VI.B-12; for cyber devices 'coordinated vulnerability disclosure and related procedures' (524B(b)(1)), which FDA considers could include the three items of VII.C.1-05..07.

external_reports.description: Coordinated disclosure of vulnerabilities and exploits identified by external entities (including third-party software suppliers and researchers)

internal_findings.description: Disclosure of vulnerabilities and exploits identified by the manufacturer

disclosure_procedures.description: Procedures to carry out disclosures; may include informing device users, customers, patients, and other relevant healthcare parties (fn62-01)

remediation_communication.description: VI.B-13 how forthcoming remediations, patches, and updates are communicated to customers

fielded_versions.description: VII.C.1-14/15: account for differences in risk management for fielded devices; assess vulnerabilities for all fielded versions

maintenance.description: VII.C.1-12/13: anticipate and make updates to the plan as new risks, threats, vulnerabilities, assets, or adverse impacts are discovered
